findings.claim: The u*z0 interaction is even under simultaneous sign reversal while the other output terms are odd.
findings.impact: Proposed interaction weakens an existing local polarity relationship. V4 context includes per-input grouped diagnostics and residual snippets but does not explicitly include V3 relation summaries; do not attribute this solely to model reasoning. No universal symmetry constraint is implied.

findings.finding: Recovery gaps 0 and 1 second produce identical seven supplied global input descriptors. The boundary schema cannot directly express a recovery-gap threshold even though the experiment compiler can vary the gap.
findings.impact: Both observed labels are high-error, so this pair does not itself refute all classifiers over those features. Failure to declare a boundary cannot establish that the model lacks capacity or that no more expressive boundary exists.
